lines.zh: 我走过荒原，草自己倒了
lines.en: I cross the waste, and the grass falls by itself.

lines.zh: 我的步子很慢，因为我不需要快
lines.en: My steps are slow because I need no speed.

lines.zh: 大地在我脚下变灰
lines.en: The ground greys beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我比这里的任何东西都年长
lines.en: I am older than anything here.

lines.zh: 我一步一步来，从不间断
lines.en: Step by step, never breaking stride.

lines.zh: 我的影子从很远就铺到你这
lines.en: My shadow reaches you from far off.

lines.zh: 我每一脚都踩在世界的边缘
lines.en: Every step lands on the world's edge.

lines.zh: 我的气息让空气变稀
lines.en: My presence thins the air.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，不是因为急
lines.en: I walk toward you, not from haste.

lines.zh: 我走了很久，还会继续走
lines.en: I have walked a long time, and will continue.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，颜色被抽走
lines.en: Where I pass, color is drawn out.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，路是自己让开的
lines.en: I do not detour; the way gives way.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一座不会动的山
lines.en: I stand like a mountain that will not move.

lines.zh: 我太老了，连饥饿都是旧的
lines.en: I am so old that even my hunger is ancient.

lines.zh: 我看着这片地，它正在死
lines.en: I watch this land; it is dying.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，只有气息
lines.en: I do not breathe; I only radiate.

lines.zh: 我是最古老的那一个
lines.en: I am the oldest of them.

lines.zh: 我从不急，我也从不走开
lines.en: I am never in a hurry, and I never leave.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，附近的草枯了
lines.en: I raise a hand, and the grass nearby withers.

lines.zh: 你们这些小东西，总在跑
lines.en: You small things are always running.

lines.zh: 我最大，也最强，也最会算
lines.en: I am the largest, the strongest, and the cleverest.

lines.zh: 时间的味道，我闻得出来
lines.en: I can smell the taste of time.

lines.zh: 我等了永恒那么久
lines.en: I have waited for eternity.

lines.zh: 这片原野是我最早走过的地方
lines.en: These plains were the first ground I crossed.

lines.zh: 我不需要看，我知道你在哪
lines.en: I need not look; I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰比土还厚
lines.en: The dust on me is thicker than soil.

lines.zh: 你要引起我的兴趣，才见得到我
lines.en: You must earn my interest to meet me.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，地面会响
lines.en: When I laugh, the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我低下头，第一次真正看你
lines.en: I lower my head and truly look at you.

lines.zh: 你引起了我的兴趣
lines.en: You have my interest.

lines.zh: 你很小，但你不逃
lines.en: You are small, but you do not run.

lines.zh: 我看你的骨头，不看你的脸
lines.en: I look at your bones, not your face.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着整个原野
lines.en: A whole plain lies between us.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，比你的身体还长
lines.en: I reach out a hand longer than your body.

lines.zh: 我认得出勇气，也认得出愚蠢
lines.en: I know courage, and I know foolishness.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，这很诚实
lines.en: You are trembling; that is honest.

lines.zh: 你要说话，就说吧
lines.en: If you have words, speak them.

lines.zh: 我等你先动
lines.en: I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你的死会很久，但不会疼太久
lines.en: Your death will be long, but the pain brief.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个走到我面前的
lines.en: I remember everyone who came before me.

lines.zh: 今天你也会被记住
lines.en: Today you too will be remembered.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，这是很久以来第一次
lines.en: I give half a step, the first in a long time.

lines.zh: 这一下让我注意到你
lines.en: That made me notice you.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫会让天塌
lines.en: I do not cry out; my cry would bring the sky down.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下一层灰
lines.en: A layer of dust falls off me.

lines.zh: 伤口没有血，只有空洞
lines.en: No blood in the wound, only emptiness.

lines.zh: 我抬手，摸了摸被打的地方
lines.en: I raise a hand to the struck spot.

lines.zh: 这么多年，你是第一个
lines.en: In all these years, you are the first.

lines.zh: 我没有生气，我只是记住了
lines.en: I am not angry; I merely remember.

lines.zh: 你确实有点本事
lines.en: You do have some skill.

lines.zh: 我们在重新开始
lines.en: We begin again.

lines.zh: 有东西想讨好我
lines.en: Something wants to please me.

lines.zh: 你举的这点东西，不够我一口
lines.en: That is not a mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我吃的是世界
lines.en: I do not eat that; I eat the world.

lines.zh: 你把手举高一点
lines.en: Raise your hand higher.

lines.zh: 我伸手接，动作很慢
lines.en: I reach to take it, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你肯给，说明你怕了
lines.en: You offer it, which means you are afraid.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里会干枯
lines.en: It will wither in my hand.

lines.zh: 我更想要你走上来
lines.en: I would rather you walked up to me.

lines.zh: 这点心意，我收下，也记住
lines.en: I accept this small gesture, and remember it.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我几乎没有感觉
lines.en: You slam into me; I barely notice.

lines.zh: 我的身体像一堵会动的墙
lines.en: My body is a moving wall.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，落在地上
lines.en: You bounce off and land on the ground.

lines.zh: 我没有让，也没有必要
lines.en: I did not yield, and need not.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我看清了你的力气
lines.en: That told me your strength.

lines.zh: 我的灰落了你一身
lines.en: My dust covers you.

lines.zh: 你就站在我影子的正中
lines.en: You stand in the exact center of my shadow.

lines.zh: 我不是不动的，我只是慢
lines.en: I am not still; I am only slow.

lines.zh: 你再撞一次，结果一样
lines.en: Try again, and it ends the same.

lines.zh: 我是最古老的那个，没有同类
lines.en: I am the oldest; I have no peer.

lines.zh: 这些小的都是我的延伸
lines.en: The small ones are my extensions.

lines.zh: 我不用成对，我只需要扩散
lines.en: I need no pairing; I only need to spread.

lines.zh: 原野就是我的伴侣
lines.en: The plains are my companion.

lines.zh: 我走的地方，会长出新的饥饿
lines.en: Where I walk, new hunger grows.

lines.zh: 没有人陪我走完，也不需要
lines.en: No one walks with me to the end, and none need to.

lines.zh: 我见过成对的，它们都消失了
lines.en: I have seen pairs; they all vanished.

lines.zh: 时间只陪着我一个
lines.en: Only time keeps me company.

lines.zh: 我一直在，从未离开
lines.en: I have always been here, never gone.

lines.zh: 你也会变成我的一部分
lines.en: You too will become part of me.

lines.zh: 我拿起它，它在我手里干枯
lines.en: I lift it, and it withers in my hand.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，我看不见
lines.en: Too small for me to see.

lines.zh: 它在我指间化成灰
lines.en: It turns to ash between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿起来，是为了研究你
lines.en: I pick it up to study you.

lines.zh: 我把它按进土里，它就不长了
lines.en: I press it into the soil, and it stops growing.

lines.zh: 这些东西填不满永恒的饿。
lines.en: These things cannot fill an eternal hunger.

lines.zh: 我把它扔得很远
lines.en: I throw it far.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我不还
lines.en: You dropped this; I will not return it.

lines.zh: 这一件，归原野了
lines.en: This belongs to the plains now.

lines.zh: 你让我有了兴趣
lines.en: You have my interest.

lines.zh: 很久没有人走到这么近
lines.en: No one has come this close in a long while.

lines.zh: 你不是最强的，但你敢来
lines.en: Not the strongest, but you came.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，就知道你怎么打
lines.en: One look and I know how you fight.

lines.zh: 这片原野是我的
lines.en: These plains are mine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，转得很慢
lines.en: I turn toward you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我在算你能撑多久
lines.en: I am calculating how long you last.

lines.zh: 我要亲自看看你
lines.en: I want to see you myself.

lines.zh: 你被选中了
lines.en: You have been chosen.

lines.zh: 那就开始吧
lines.en: Then let us begin.

lines.zh: 我抬手，草全枯了
lines.en: I raise a hand and the grass all withers.

lines.zh: 这是永恒里的一小段
lines.en: This is a small stretch of eternity.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不紧不慢
lines.en: I follow, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 你跑，我看着，很省力
lines.en: You run; I watch, using no effort.

lines.zh: 这片地都是我的，你出不去
lines.en: All this land is mine; you cannot leave it.

lines.zh: 你的每一步我都记得
lines.en: I remember every step you take.

lines.zh: 我不堵路，路自己会消失
lines.en: I do not block the road; the road vanishes.

lines.zh: 我等你跑到没有力气
lines.en: I wait until you have no strength left.

lines.zh: 你很会躲，但躲不了太久
lines.en: You hide well, but not for long.

lines.zh: 我抬手，前方长出枯草
lines.en: I raise a hand, and dead grass grows ahead.

lines.zh: 地面在你脚下变软
lines.en: The ground softens under your feet.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着，连呼吸都没有
lines.en: I follow without even breathing.

lines.zh: 你听到的是风声，不是风
lines.en: What you hear is wind, but not the wind.

lines.zh: 我就在你身后不远
lines.en: I am not far behind you.

lines.zh: 这地方曾经有很多人
lines.en: Once there were many people here.

lines.zh: 我一只手压下来
lines.en: I bring one hand down.

lines.zh: 这一下把地面砸出一个坑
lines.en: That left a crater.

lines.zh: 我不快，但你躲不开
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 我抓住你，举起来看
lines.en: I take you and lift you to look.

lines.zh: 你在我手里很小
lines.en: You are very small in my hand.

lines.zh: 我握了一下，又松开
lines.en: I close my grip, then open it.

lines.zh: 这一击带走了你一部分力气
lines.en: That took part of your strength.

lines.zh: 我很有耐心地再来一次
lines.en: I try again, patiently.

lines.zh: 你还没倒，我有点欣赏
lines.en: You have not fallen; I am somewhat impressed.

lines.zh: 最后我会把你放回去
lines.en: At the end I will set you back down.

lines.zh: 地面先失去颜色
lines.en: The ground loses its color first.

lines.zh: 空气变稀，我知道它来了
lines.en: The air thins; I know it has come.

lines.zh: 它没有刷出来，它是被请来的
lines.en: It was not spawned; it was invited.

lines.zh: 为了见它，你得先引起它的兴趣
lines.en: To meet it, first earn its interest.

lines.zh: 远处的地平线上多了一道影子
lines.en: A shape joins the horizon far off.

lines.zh: 风停了，草不再动
lines.en: The wind stops; the grass stops moving.

lines.zh: 它比你以为的大得多
lines.en: It is far larger than you think.

lines.zh: 最古老的那个，终于动了
lines.en: The oldest one has finally moved.

lines.zh: 这里的味道变了，像旧血
lines.en: The smell changes here, like old blood.

lines.zh: 一场很久以后才会结束的事开始了
lines.en: Something began that will end long from now.

lines.zh: 它迈出第一步，地在沉
lines.en: It takes its first step, and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 这不是遭难，这是收割
lines.en: This is not a calamity; it is a harvest.

lines.zh: 它看向你，只是因为你站在那里
lines.en: It looks at you only because you are standing there.

lines.zh: 天边最后一点绿也没了
lines.en: The last green on the horizon is gone.

lines.zh: 火烧到我身上，像点着一座山
lines.en: Fire touches me as if lighting a mountain.

lines.zh: 我落下去，砸穿了地面
lines.en: I fall and break through the ground.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我把水也吸干
lines.en: Water rises, and I drink it dry.

lines.zh: 爆炸在我身上只是响了一下
lines.en: The blast is only a noise against me.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我身上，像根刺
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股力推了我一下，很轻
lines.en: That force nudges me, faintly.

lines.zh: 我就是饥饿，饿不到我
lines.en: I am hunger; hunger cannot starve me.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我们互相看了一会儿
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and we regard each other.

lines.zh: 连原野都没有了，只剩我
lines.en: Even the plains are gone; only I remain.
